routing_warnings.description: The requirement to use the same design across all four reports concerns coordination of the report variants rather than the holistic visual quality of one report design.
The reported RR01 labels in the RR02–RR04 headers concern version-specific identifier correctness rather than header presence or presentation.
The request to send editable source files for customer-ready PDF export concerns source-template handoff rather than the behavior of individual customer fields.
Delivery of updated editable versions concerns the source-template format and handoff Requirement.
The complaint that only Word documents were delivered concerns required editable source formats, not customer-field editability.
The claimed delivery of Word and Canva versions concerns editable source-template formats.
The footer issue concerns incorrect version-specific RR codes rather than footer presence or visual consistency.
The remaining footer defect is specifically that RR02, RR03, and RR04 display the wrong report identifier.

missing_requirement_candidates.suggested_title: Final PDF Exports for All Report Variants
missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client independently requests final PDF exports for RR01, RR02, RR03, and RR04, which is separate from delivery of editable source templates and has no matching Requirement in the frozen inventory.
